authority: Consolidated Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 + official amendment annotations + DCA FAQ support
purpose: Controlled Rule 6 patch to be merged into the MVP registry only after remaining Rule 6 clauses are frozen.

rules.current_requirement: Manufacturer/packer/importer identity and address declaration, with the Rule 6 explanations governing unnamed manufacturer wording and brand-owner responsibility.
special_pathways: Food packages: this clause does not apply; FSS Act 2006 and rules apply.

rules.current_requirement: Imported products must state country of origin/manufacture/assembly.
Common or generic name of commodity; packages containing more than one product require name and number or quantity of each product.
Net quantity in standard unit of weight/measure, or number where packed/sold by number.

Current September 2026 baseline must not retain the older 'manufactured or pre-packed or imported' wording as the default. The 2021 amendment omitted 'or pre-packed or imported', effective 1 October 2022. Apply the current manufacture month/year requirement subject to the explicit food, seed, cosmetic and other-law pathways in the rule.
manual_review_conditions: Date applicability cannot be established from commodity context.

rules.current_requirement: If a commodity may become unfit for human consumption after a period, best-before or use-by date, month and year must be declared; no requirement under this clause where another law makes provision.
Retail sale price of the package must be declared, subject to stated exceptions.
exceptions: Domestic LPG cylinders whose price is covered by the Government Administrative Price Mechanism.

rules.current_requirement: MRP must clearly indicate maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes and be expressed in Indian currency. The 2021 amendment's current wording supersedes the older historical rounding formulation.
Where commodity size is relevant, dimensions of the commodity and, where relevant, dimensions of each different piece must be declared.
Other matters specified elsewhere in the Rules, including explicit date/MRP exceptions and special declaration conditions.
Name, address, telephone number and e-mail address of the person or office that can be contacted for consumer complaints.
rules.interpretation: E-mail is mandatory in the current effective wording. Address may be referred to elsewhere on the label.

rules.current_requirement: Individual stickers may not be used to alter or make declarations required under the Rules, except a sticker reducing MRP may be used if it does not cover the original MRP declaration.
rules.source_discrepancy: The DCA FAQ calls this Rule 6(2), while the consolidated rule text places it at Rule 6(3). Consolidated rule numbering controls the machine source reference; FAQ wording is retained as supporting evidence.

rules.current_requirement: Applicable retail packages require unit sale price on the principal display panel, subject to the rule's exemptions and provisos.
exceptions: Wholesale packages do not require unit sale price.
No declaration where MRP equals unit sale price.
Free additional quantity is excluded from the unit-sale-price computation.

rules.current_requirement: Unit sale price is inclusive of all taxes, displayed on PDP, and rounded to nearest two decimal places; whole-number values may be shown without decimals.

E-commerce entity must display Rule 6(1) mandatory declarations on its digital/electronic network except month/year manufacture or packing; marketplace responsibility has the rule's intermediary conditions.
rules.special_note: Unit sale price is not required on e-commerce websites according to the DCA FAQ.

rules.current_requirement: Every e-commerce entity selling imported products must provide searchable and sortable product-listing filter specifying country of origin.

not_yet_frozen: Full amendment chronology for every Rule 6 clause.
Exact interaction with commodity-specific rules and other-law overrides.
